# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew is an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure and stooping shoulders. He has long iron-gray hair and wears a full, soft brown beard that he has had since he was twenty years old.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew is exceptionally shy, quiet, and soft-spoken. He dreads almost all women, except his sister Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde, feeling as though they are secretly laughing at him. Despite his fear of strangers, he is gentle, deeply loving, and immensely generous, acting as a sympathetic listener and steadfast advocate for Anne Shirley.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017)_

## Traits

- Shy and quiet  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014)</sub>
- Fear of women and strangers  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012)</sub>
- Generous and soft-hearted  <sub>[v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming  <sub>[v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014)</sub>

## Goals

- To support and provide for Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert travels to Bright River station expecting to collect an orphan boy sent from Nova Scotia to assist with farm work at Green Gables. Upon arrival, he finds only Anne Shirley waiting on the platform and, despite his overwhelming shyness around strange girls, decides to bring her home to Green Gables to let Marilla manage the mistake. Along the drive, he quickly takes a liking to Anne's expressive chatter and glowing imagination, silently resolving that she must stay. Over time, Matthew becomes Anne's constant defender and confidant, spoiling her with quiet kindnesses, such as supporting her artistic ambitions and buying her a stylish dress with puffed sleeves. He takes immense pride in her academic successes at school and Queen's Academy. Tragically, Matthew suffers a sudden, fatal collapse, leaving Marilla and Anne to mourn his passing deeply.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c2 P20](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0020), [v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014)_

- Lived at Green Gables in Avonlea on Prince Edward Island with his sister Marilla  <sub>[v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002), [v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016)</sub>
